The four curves are labeled ①②③④ respectively. The curve corresponding to place ③ bends downward to the right and intersects the horizontal axis near the sunrise time of 0:00 on the vertical axis; from reading the figure, its horizontal coordinate is about 15°. Reasoning: According to the meaning of the question, a sunrise time of 0:00 can be regarded as the critical state for place ③ entering polar day. Therefore, when the latitude of the direct solar point is greater than about 15°, place ③ experiences polar day. The direct solar point moves back and forth between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn within one year; it reaches around 15° about 1 month before the Northern Hemisphere summer solstice and falls back to around 15° about 1 month after the summer solstice, so the duration of polar day at place ③ within one year is about 2 months.

method.method_draft: 从图中先确定③地曲线在日出时间为0时对应的太阳直射点纬度约为15°。题目问一年内③地极昼持续时间，则把太阳直射点纬度大于约15°的时段视为③地极昼期。结合太阳直射点一年内在南北回归线间往返移动的节律，北半球夏至前约1个月达到15°，夏至后约1个月又降回15°，所以持续时间约为2个月。
